column1: # The sim mutants (ADR 0009 point 6; verification.md section 1): each KSIM_MUTANT("name") switch, the
# gates/rows/p1.tsv row it must fail (or - for a mutant only a procedure test kills) and the
# misbehaviour it plants. tools/guards/check_mutants.py keeps this file and the code in step;
# tools/mutants.sh (N16) runs each one against its row.

column3: the null-scheme SUCI carries the whole IMSI instead of the MSIN (TS 33.501 6.12.2, TS 23.003 2.2B)
K_AMF derived with the SUPI in its SBI form "imsi-..." instead of its digits (TS 33.501 A.7.0)
K_gNB derived from the next uplink NAS COUNT instead of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE's (TS 33.501 6.8.1.2.2)
a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST sent while a back-off timer runs for its DNN and S-NSSAI (TS 24.501 6.4.1.4.3)
a paging record for the UE is not answered with a service request (TS 24.501 5.6.2.2.1)
after a network de-registration with "re-registration required" the UE does not register again (TS 24.501 5.5.2.3.2)
the DU never reports a UE it no longer hears from, so no release request with radio connection with UE lost (TS 38.473 8.3.2)
EF.5GS3GPPLOCI is neither written nor read, so a power cycle loses the 5G-GUTI (TS 31.102 4.4.11.2, TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.4)
RP-DA left empty instead of the service centre of EF.SMSP, so the SC refuses the submit (TS 24.011 7.3.1.2; L7)
the PC/SC transport drops a response's data and keeps SW1 SW2, so the UE never reads its card (P2 Q1)
the card bridge lets VERIFY ADM1 and AF20/AF30 writes through without --admin (P2 Q1)
the CU-CP drops its UEs when F1 is lost and tells the AMF nothing (P2 Q2; tests/procedure Ran.Mutant_f1_loss_silent_*; row ksim-p2.f1-loss-release from Q3)
the DU sends every UE's F1AP on stream 1 (P2 Q2; tests/procedure Ran.Mutant_single_ue_stream_*; row ksim-p2.per-ue-stream from Q3)
the DU sends no F1 SETUP REQUEST on a new F1 association, so after a CU-CP restart its cell stays off (P2 Q3)
the DU sends no NR-U DL DATA DELIVERY STATUS, so a CU-UP that waits for a desired buffer size (OCUDU's) sends no DL data (P2 Q4)
the CU-UP never sends BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVITY NOTIFICATION, so an idle UE with a session is never released for user inactivity (P2 Q5)
